html:
Snow ice cream (also known as bingsu) is made from Japanese kakigori shaved ice, an attractive snack chosen by many tourists, especially young people in hot weather, enjoying a cup of snow ice cream is really interesting, what could be better than a summer day in the Central region, let’s enjoy snow ice cream, an attractive dish in Da Nang with Vietlook today.

Snow ice cream is often combined with fresh fruit, peanuts, red beans, black sesame, green tea, crushed biscuits, coconut milk, shaved ice with condensed milk… bringing a delicious flavor, an attractive dish when traveling to Da Nang in the summer, tourists should enjoy it to feel the delicious flavor of the Central region.

For any tourist when traveling to Da Nang in the summer, tourists should enjoy a cup of snow ice cream to feel the delicious flavor, a light but pure dish of the cuisine here.

If you are a mango lover, do not forget to enjoy a cup of mango snow ice cream with delicious fruits of snow ice cream with a layer of cool shaved ice, mixed together to bring a fragrant flavor.

In addition, when going on a tour of Da Nang, visitors can also enjoy fresh seafood, the seafood here is bought by the locals at the boat when the boat just docked, so it is very fresh, or enjoy street snacks.

Especially sipping a cup of coffee, watching the beauty of the coastal city, or enjoying cakes with the ingenuity of talented chefs will bring diners delicious and attractive dishes when coming to Da Nang. But the dish to cool down in the summer noon must include a cup of snow ice cream, you should enjoy it at least once in your life.

In addition to enjoying ice cream, visitors to Da Nang can also enjoy attractive snacks that will make them remember the cuisine of the Central region forever.

Da Nang Sau Lien Che

As one of the snacks chosen by many tourists, especially young people, Sau Che is a great dish to cool down in the summer when enjoying a cup of chè while watching the scenery, there is nothing more interesting.

Banh trang kep

This is a familiar dish, but Da Nang Banh Trang Kep brings its own delicious flavor, visitors when traveling to Da Nang in the summer cannot miss Banh Trang Kep.

Banh Trang Cuon Thit Pork

A famous specialty in Da Nang, Banh Trang is served with dipping sauce, adding to the rich and delicious flavor of the dish, Banh Trang with pork belly, and various herbs bring the delicious flavor of the Central region cuisine.

Danang Fish Noodles

The dish is no longer strange to Vietnamese people, however, Danang fish noodles are prepared in a unique way with herbs and spices, bringing diners a new taste of Danang cuisine.

Danang Snails

The dish can be enjoyed right at sidewalk eateries, hot snails served with ginger, garlic, and chili sauce, the price is reasonable, so it is chosen by many diners.

Braised beef slices

An attractive snack chosen by many tourists, or can be bought as a gift when having the opportunity to visit Danang.

Danang salted milk crab

Milk crab is processed into dishes with the sweet taste of crab and the spicy taste of chili, in addition, diners can also enjoy the nutritious salted milk crab dish chosen by many diners.

Grilled spring rolls

Spring rolls are made from ground pork, with a little seasoning, served with raw vegetables and dipping sauce with spices such as: Garlic, shallots, pepper… the most characteristic of Da Nang spring rolls is the dipping sauce that brings a delicious flavor to diners.
